title: Accelerating interfacial desolvation kinetics using NaF-rich composite sodium for high-performance all-climate sodium–metal batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,3278-3287
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05369A, Paper
Tongtong Deng, Chen Li, Guanjie Lu, Zongyang Li, Chaohe Xu, Ronghua Wang
The NaF-rich composite sodium can endow the anode's interface a good thermal stability at 60 °C and accelerate the desolvation of Na+-solvent clusters at −40 °C, finally exhibiting a stable all-climate performance in ester-based electrolyte.
